# Command: init

Triggers: "start a new SaaS project", "scaffold a multi-tenant app", "set up
tidyfactor-next", "init".

Loads: `../workflows/init.md` + `../memory/spec.md` + `../architecture-doc-skeleton.md`.

Outcome: a running Next.js 16 + Supabase project with tenant isolation wired
in from commit one, and a filled-in `ARCHITECTURE.md` recording every
per-project choice so later commands don't re-ask.
